content.summary: Four adult theater friends compress an autumn day into a maple farewell. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.recommended_input: Follow four clearly adult community-theater friends through one late-autumn day anchored by red maple leaves. Let a rooftop lantern circle become the warm group crest. End on one adult woman facing a maple grove as translucent memories of the same four adults gather behind her.
